title: katam object type (katam-object/1)
description: Per-type data of an enemy, item, gadget or boss: what the game keeps in a table (score, hit points, copy ability, tile budget). Behaviour is code; see docs/design/authoring/enemies.md.

numTiles.description: OBJ VRAM tiles reserved when it spawns.

raw.description: Descriptor fields by C name (unk0, unk1, unk2, unk4, unk8, pad0A).

code.description: ROM addresses of the type's constructor and animation bank: references to code, kept verbatim.
